summary: Innate Pharma S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026 carrying an Exhibit 99.1 press release reporting third-quarter 2026 business and financial results. The release covers pipeline updates (IPH4502 Nectin-4 ADC Phase 1 dose-escalation data to be presented at ENA on November 18, 2026; lacutamab with Sobi progressing toward first dosing in the Phase 3 TELLOMAK-3 trial in Q1 2027 and an FDA accelerated approval filing in Sézary syndrome in H2 2027; the AstraZeneca-led PACIFIC-9 readout expected in H1 2027) and a cash position of €96.8 million as of September 30, 2026, with an anticipated cash horizon through the end of Q1 2028. No transaction, corporate action, or special-situation terms are disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly foreign private issuer earnings update, with a conference call scheduled the same day.
